tal-a27-p01 · verses 27.1-27.10 · WITHHELD

athocyate liṅgapūjā sūcitā mālinīmate // 1b eteṣāmūrdhvaśāstroktamantrāṇāṃ na pratiṣṭhitam / bahiṣkuryāttato hyete rahasyatvena siddhidāḥ svavīryānandamāhātmyapraveśavaśaśālinīm / ye siddhiṃ dadate teṣāṃ bāhyatvaṃ rūpavicyutiḥ kiṃca coktaṃ samāveśapūrṇo bhoktrātmakaḥ śivaḥ / bhogalāmpaṭyabhāgbhogavicchede nigrahātmakaḥ śāntatvanyakkriyodbhūtajighatsāvṛṃhitaṃ vapuḥ / svayaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena so@syābhoge vinaśyati uktaṃ jñānottarāyāṃ ca tadetatparameśinā / śivo yāgapriyo yasmādviśeṣānmātṛmadhyagaḥ tasmādrahasyaśāstreṣu ye mantrāstānbudho bahiḥ / na pratiṣṭhāpayejjātu viśeṣādvyaktarūpiṇaḥ ata eva mṛtasyārthe pratiṣṭhānyatra yoditā / sātra śāstreṣu no kāryā kāryā sādhāraṇī punaḥ ā tanmayatvasaṃsiddherā cābhīṣṭaphalodayāt / putrakaḥ sādhako vyaktamavyaktaṃ vā samāśrayet putrakairgururabhyarthyaḥ sādhakastu svayaṃ vidan / yadi tatsthāpayenno cettenāpyarthyo gururbhavet

tal-a27-p02 · verses 27.11-27.20 · WITHHELD

guruścātra nirodhākhye kāla itthaṃ vibhau vadet / jīvatyasminphalāntaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭherjīvāvadhīti vā liṅgaṃ ca bāṇaliṅgaṃ vā ratnajaṃ vātha mauktikam / pauṣpamānnamatho vāstraṃ gandhadravyakṛtaṃ ca vā natu pāṣāṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ śilpyutthaṃ parikalpayet / dhātūtthaṃ ca suvarṇotthavarjamanyadvivarjayet na cātra liṅgamānādi kvacidapyupayujyate / udāravīryairmantrairyadbhāsitaṃ phaladaṃ hi tat tasyāpi sthaṇḍilādyuktavidhinā śuddhimācaret / mantrārpaṇaṃ tathaiva syānnirodhastūktayuktitaḥ agnau ca tarpaṇaṃ bhūriviśeṣāddakṣiṇā guroḥ / dīnāditṛptirvibhavādyāga ityadhiko vidhiḥ sarveṣvavyaktaliṅgeṣu pradhānaṃ syādakalpitam / tathā ca tatra tatroktaṃ lakṣaṇe pārameśvare sūtre pātre dhvaje vastre svayambhūbāṇapūjite / nadīprasravaṇotthe ca nāhvānaṃ nāpi kalpanā pīṭhaprasādamantrāṃśavelādiniyamo naca / vyaktaṃ vā citrapustādau devadārusuvarṇajam atha dīkṣitasacchilpikṛtaṃ sthāpayate guruḥ / athavā lakṣaṇopetamūrdhatatkarparāśritam

tal-a27-p03 · verses 27.21-27.30 · WITHHELD

paṅkticakrakaśūlābjavidhinā tūramāśrayet / tallakṣaṇaṃ bruve śrīmatpicuśāstre nirūpitam tūre yogaḥ sadā śastaḥ siddhido doṣavarjite / jālakairjarjarai randhrairdantairūnādhikai rujā yukte ca tūre hāniḥ syāt taddhīne yāga uttamaḥ / kāmya eva bhavettūramiti kecitprapedire guravastu vidhau kāmye yatnāddoṣāṃstyajediti / vyācakṣate picuproktaṃ na nitye karmaṇītyadaḥ śrīsiddhātantra uktaṃ ca tūralakṣaṇamuttamam / ekādikacatuṣkhaṇḍe gomukhe pūrṇacandrake padmagorocanāmuktānīrasphaṭikasaṃnibhe / ekādipañcasadrandhravidyārekhānvite śubhe na rūkṣavakraśakaladīrghanimnasabinduke / ślakṣṇayā vajrasūcyātra sphuṭaṃ devīgaṇānvitam sarvaṃ samālikhetpūjyaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram / etadevānusartavyamarghapātre@pi lakṣaṇam śrībrahmayāmale@pyuktaṃ pātraṃ gomukhamuttamam / gajakūrmatalaṃ kumbhavṛttaśaktikajākṛti akṣasūtramatho kuryāttatraivābhyarcayetkramam / vīradhātujalodbhūtamuktāratnasuvarṇajam

tal-a27-p04 · verses 27.31-27.40 · WITHHELD

akṣasūtraṃ kramotkṛṣṭaṃ raudrākṣaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ / śataṃ tithyuttaraṃ yadvā sāṣṭaṃ yadvā tadardhakam tadardhaṃ vātha pañcāśadyuktaṃ tatparikalpayet / vaktrāṇi pañca citspandajñānecchākṛtisaṃgateḥ pañcadhādyantagaṃ caikyamityupāntyākṣago vidhiḥ / śaktitadvatprabhedena tatra dvairūpyamucyate tato dviguṇamāne tu dvirūpaṃ nyāsamācaret / tato@pi dviguṇe sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtidvitayena tam mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vātha nyasyetkhaśarasaṃmite / uttame tu dvayīṃ nyasyennyasya pūrvaṃ pracoditān dīkṣāyāṃ mukhyato mantrāṃstānpañcadaśa daiśikaḥ / yadi vā tattvabhuvanakalāmantrapadārṇajaiḥ saṃkhyābhedaiḥ kṛte sūtre taṃ taṃ nyāsaṃ guruścaret / kṛtvākṣasūtraṃ tasyāpi sarvaṃ sthaṇḍilavadbhavet pūjitena ca tenaiva japaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ / vidhiruktastvayaṃ śrīmanmālinīvijayottare cakravadbhramayannetadyadvakti sa japo bhavet / yadīkṣate juhotyetadbodhāgnau saṃpraveśanāt athavārghamahāpātraṃ kuryāttaccottaraṃ param / nārikelamatho bailvaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ ca vā

tal-a27-p05 · verses 27.41-27.50 · WITHHELD

tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pratiṣṭhādau prakīrtitaḥ / tanniṣkamparasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvāsminpūjayetkramam adhomukhaṃ sadā sthāpyaṃ pūjitaṃ pūjane punaḥ / tatpātramunmukhaṃ tacca riktaṃ kuryānna tādṛśam pūjānte tadrasāpūrṇamātmānaṃ pravidhāya tat / adhomukhaṃ ca saṃpūjya sthāpayet vicakṣaṇaḥ khaṅgaṃ kṛpāṇikāṃ yadvā kartarīṃ makuraṃ ca vā / vimalaṃ tattathā kuryācchrīmatkālīmukhoditam śrībhairavakule@pyuktaṃ kulaparvaprapūjane / sthaṇḍile@gnau paṭe liṅge pātre padme@tha maṇḍale mūrtau ghaṭe@strasaṃghāte dhaṭe sūtre@tha pūjayet / svena svenopacāreṇa saṅkaraṃ varjayediti yathāpsu śāntaye mantrāstadvadastrādiṣu dhruvam / śatrucchedādikartāraḥ kāmyo@taḥ saṅkarojjhitaḥ akāmasya tu te tattatsthānopādhivaśāddhruvam / pāśakartanasaṃśuddhatattvāpyāyādikāriṇaḥ athavā pustakaṃ tādṛgrahaḥśāstrakramombhitam / suśuddhaṃ dīkṣitakṛtaṃ tatrāpyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ itthaṃ svayaṃpratiṣṭheṣu yāvadyāvatsthitirbhavet / vibhavaistarpaṇaṃ śuddhistāvadvicchedavarjanam

tal-a27-p06 · verses 27.51-27.59 · WITHHELD

ata eva yadā bhūridinaṃ maṇḍalakalpanam / tadā dine dine kuryādvibhavaistarpaṇaṃ bahu pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca sarvatra guruḥ pūrvoditaṃ param / satattvamanusandhāya saṃnidhiṃ sphuṭamācaret siddhe tu tanmayībhāve phale putrakasādhakaiḥ / anyasmai taddvayādanyatarasmai tatsamarpyate tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvastadalābhe tu sarvathā / agādhe@mbhasi tatkṣepyaṃ kṣamayitvā visṛjya ca ityeṣa svapratiṣṭhānavidhiḥ śivanirūpitaḥ / parapratiṣṭhite liṅge bāṇīye@tha svayaṃbhuvi sarvamāsanapakṣe prāṅnyasya saṃpūjayetkramam / śuddhāśuddhādhvajāḥ sarve mantrāḥ sarvaḥ śivāntakaḥ adhvā cehāsane proktastatsarvatrārcayedidam / āvāhanavisṛṣṭī tu tatra prāgvatsamācaret uktaṃ tantre@pyaghoreśe svacchande vibhunā tathā / athavā pratyahaṃ proktamānārdhārdhaniyogataḥ kṛtveṣṭaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra samastaṃ kramamarcayet / bahuprakārabhinnasya liṅgasyārcā nirūpitā
